content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses pakistan

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned stack that replaces platforms like Stripe and PayPal. It combines free hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), serverless backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), and file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which verifies on-chain crypto transactions with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. This architecture gives creators full data ownership, zero platform dependency, and immunity to payment network restrictions. It’s not a patch—it’s a base-layer redesign for regions where conventional tools fail.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, serving your product pages. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handling order processing and payment verification. Orders are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets, and product files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments integrates via webhook, firing the moment a payment confirms on-chain. This system operates without APIs from Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, using only tools you control. Deployment takes 48 hours, and the stack scales as needed without platform fees or geographic restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or unreliable. Creators in Pakistan, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other excluded markets sell ebooks, courses, templates, and software but cannot collect payment through conventional means. A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. This stack eliminates platform risk by giving creators full ownership of their commerce infrastructure. It’s designed for those who prioritize permanence over workarounds.
Stripe operates in only 46 of 195 countries—this stack works in all 195.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, global hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver product files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies and no buyer accounts required. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. Each component is free or low-cost, and the stack is deployed in 48 hours with no ongoing fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for GitHub Pages + Apps Script or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase. Both include deployment within 48 hours and 30-day support. For full documentation and templates, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and a scaling playbook. Deploy your stack, load your products, and begin selling with no platform dependencies. This is how creators in excluded markets build permanent commerce infrastructure.

Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Load your products and test end-to-end. Launch your stack and begin selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in Nigeria or Ghana?

Yes, this stack is designed for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. It uses globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to ensure full functionality.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. If it fails, you can replace it with another crypto payment gateway without disrupting your stack. Your infrastructure remains intact.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the buyer’s wallet. This is documented in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) refund playbook.
Can I scale this stack to handle thousands of orders?
Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes scaling configurations for high-volume sales. Supabase and Cloudflare Workers are designed to handle large-scale operations without additional fees.
What if I don’t know how to code?
